environment: Forest floor, exposed roots, soil surface, damp leaf litter
typical_encounters: Ground predators (gastornis, bergisuchus, groundCarnivore, lesmesodon, pakicetus, crocodile), snakes, terrestrial invertebrates (beetles, ants, centipedes, scorpions), ground forageables (fallen fruit, mushrooms, rhizomes, nuts), carcasses, termite mounds, large ground nests
threat_profile: Highest predator danger; crocodile and pakicetus present near water; gastornis is floor-dominant; open ground exposes the player to all ground threats
notes: Climbing removes the player from most Ground threats; staying on the ground is always the highest-risk posture

environment: Dense shrub layer, low branches, thick leaf cover, tangled vegetation
typical_encounters: Invertebrates (spiders, caterpillars, slugs, mantids), small lizards (gecko, anole), shrub-level fruits (redBerries, purpleBerries, stranglerFigFruit), ferns, fungi, tree crabs, tree frogs, small mammals (leptictidium, amphiperatherium), wood grubs, snake species, wasp nests
threat_profile: Mix of minor food-threats and occasional predators (bergisuchus, climbingHunter, cariamiform); highest raw encounter count per layer
notes: Broadest encounter variety in the game; many small invertebrate food sources alongside real predator risk from climbing threats

environment: Middle tree layer, main structural branches, bark surfaces, tree hollows
typical_encounters: Arboreal primates (darwinius, europolemur, godinotia), arboreal mammals (kopidodon, heterohyus), mid-canopy birds (ramphastos, messelornis, smallBird), canopy fruits (stranglerFigFruit, laurelDrupe, canopyFruit), flying insects (dragonfly, moth, butterfly), bird nests, aerial predators (owl, masillaraptor)
threat_profile: Aerial predators (owl, masillaraptor) are the main danger; most ground predators cannot follow; climbingHunter can follow
notes: Primary arboreal social zone; primate competitors frequent here; bird nests provide high-value food with low predator risk

environment: High canopy, terminal branches, upper crown, aerial exposure
typical_encounters: High-value fruits (canopyFruit, stranglerFigFruit, palmFruit), arboreal birds (smallBird, woodpeckerBird, hummingbird, fruitBat), apex aerial predators (eagle, masillaraptor), arboreal lizards (gecko, anole, iguana), flying insects (leafInsect, stickInsect, butterfly)
threat_profile: Eagle is the primary apex threat; climbingHunter can follow; open canopy creates aerial-attack windows
notes: Richest fruit resources; highest competition from birds; eagle attacks from above through canopy gaps — dense cover is the only defence
